biology: The host is recorded as Delonix regia.
soldier: Soldier head capsule pale yellow, mandibles reddish brown and semi-translucent, mandibular bases yellowish brown, labrum pale yellow tinged with white and the labral margin translucent, anteclypeus white-yellow, postclypeus yellowish brown, antennae pale yellow, the frontal gland pore and compound eyes almost concolorous with the head capsule; thorax, abdomen and legs all paler than the head capsule. The whole pilosity is sparse; the periphery of the pronotum bears only a few scattered marginal hairs, with two in the middle region.
